eyebrow.zh: 按 token 预算组织仓库文件，跟踪内容变化，并通过 CLI 或 MCP 提供项目上下文。
eyebrow.en: Organize repository files within a token budget, track content changes and expose project context through CLI or MCP.

headline.zh: 给仓库上下文一个可检查的计划。
headline.en: Give repository context an inspectable plan.

sub.zh: 按 token 预算组织仓库文件，跟踪内容变化，并通过 CLI 或 MCP 提供项目上下文。
sub.en: Organize repository files within a token budget, track content changes and expose project context through CLI or MCP.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: 文件与层次可直接查看。
稳定前缀与正文分别组织。
body.en: Stable prefix and body are organized separately.

body.zh: SQLite 保存本地变化依据。
把很多文件交给模型之前，先要知道哪些文件会被纳入、顺序是什么、相对上次修改了哪些内容。ctxfeed 用 ShardPlan 表达这些选择，保留稳定前缀、正文和变化集合，方便检查一次查询实际组织了什么。
body.en: Before sending many files to a model, inspect which files fit, their ordering and what changed since the last plan. ctxfeed represents those choices in a ShardPlan containing a stable prefix, repository body and change set.

body.zh: 完整脚本创建两份临时文件，连续构建三次计划。结果中的 cached_fraction 是本地文件哈希复用比例，不是模型缓存命中或实测费用。
body.en: The complete script creates two temporary files and builds three plans. cached_fraction is the fraction of locally known file hashes, not model-cache telemetry or measured billing.

alt.en: The complete script creates two temporary files and builds three plans. cached_fraction is the fraction of locally known file hashes, not model-cache telemetry or measured billing.

body.zh: ingest 扫描并计数文件，shard 按预算和稳定顺序构建计划，CachePlan 将文件哈希写到仓库自己的 SQLite 缓存。CLI 和 MCP 共用该路径，模型适配器在查询时发送组装后的上下文。delta 是本地变化账本，不代表仅发送变化内容，也不是服务端 prefix cache 遥测。
body.en: ingest scans and counts files; shard builds a budgeted, ordered plan. CachePlan stores file hashes in repository-scoped SQLite. CLI and MCP share this path, and model adapters send assembled context on queries. The delta is local bookkeeping: it does not mean only changed content is transmitted or measure provider prefix-cache behavior.

CLI and MCP share this path, and model adapters send assembled context on queries. The delta is local bookkeeping: it does not mean only changed content is transmitted or measure provider prefix-cache behavior.

body.zh: CLI 提供 init、add、cost、mcp。MCP 的 list_files 展示文件与缓存标记，query_repo 提交问题，cost_delta 按仓库内的静态费率估算。GLM 与 DeepSeek 是可选适配器，不会自动完成模型供应商间的运行时故障切换。
body.en: The CLI exposes init, add, cost and mcp. MCP list_files shows files and cache markers, query_repo submits a question and cost_delta estimates from repository-defined rates. GLM and DeepSeek are selectable adapters, not automatic runtime failover.

body.zh: `--model` 优先于 `CTXFEED_MODEL`，可选 glm 或 deepseek。GLM 读取 `ZHIPU_API_KEY`/`GLM_API_KEY`，DeepSeek 读取 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。IngestConfig 管理 window、headroom、max_file_bytes 和 cache_db；默认缓存为 `.ctxfeed/cache.db`。供应商模型名、窗口和费率是适配器中的配置假设，应按实际账户核对。
body.en: `--model` overrides `CTXFEED_MODEL`; values are glm or deepseek. GLM reads `ZHIPU_API_KEY`/`GLM_API_KEY`; DeepSeek reads `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. IngestConfig owns window, headroom, max_file_bytes and cache_db, defaulting to `.ctxfeed/cache.db`. Adapter model names, windows and rates are configuration assumptions to check against the actual account.

note.en: The complete script creates two temporary files and builds three plans. cached_fraction is the fraction of locally known file hashes, not model-cache telemetry or measured billing.

body.zh: 首次、未修改、修改一次的变化集合分别是 2、0、1。
body.en: The first, unchanged and edited plans contain 2, 0 and 1 changed hashes.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+ 与 uv。演示只构建本地计划，无需 API key；首次 tokenizer 使用可能需要缓存其编码文件。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+ and uv. The example only builds local plans and needs no API key; first tokenizer use may populate encoding-file caches.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/ctxfeed.git
cd ctxfeed
uv venv --python 3.12
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .

limitations.zh: 文件可能因忽略规则、大小或预算被跳过；不能保证任意仓库完整进入上下文。
limitations.en: Files can be skipped due to ignore rules, size or budget; arbitrary repositories are not guaranteed to fit.

limitations.zh: dry-run 答案是内置模拟结果，cost 是静态估算；本示例没有调用模型。
limitations.en: Dry-run answers are built-in simulations and cost is a static estimate; this example calls no model.
